en.text:
Requires a <void/>Void Melee to be equipped in order to function.

Killing <void/>Weakened enemies grants 30% <void/>Void Melee Energy and releases a <void/>Weakening puff of <void/>Void Smoke at their location.

<void/>Void Smoke is functionally identical to <void/>Smoke Bomb and triggers melee-associated effects.
